scope: Keep primary native admissions, selected correction/flip results, reports, source provenance and small matrices. Retire large historical replay/FD and phase/checkpoint working tapes. Current named/27 indexed P1/P2 raw datasets stay unchanged.
loss_disclosure: This is a lossy retention decision, not an archive of the entire old proof workspace. Original dense fine replay traces, FD spectrum tapes and some old phase/checkpoint families are unavailable. Historical reports/decisions remain historical and are not newly certified.
